name: finautojobs
description: FinAutoJobs - Full Stack Job Portal Application

scripts.preinstall: echo '📦 Installing dependencies for FinAutoJobs monorepo...'
scripts.install: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ Dependencies installed successfully for both frontend and backend!'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && echo '✅ Build complete!'
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: echo '⚠️  Backend does not require build (Node.js runtime)'
scripts.start:frontend: echo '⚠️  Frontend is static - serve frontend/dist with backend'
scripts.deploy: echo '🚀 Deploying FinAutoJobs...' && npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run start:production
scripts.deploy:build: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && npm run lint || echo 'Backend lint not configured'
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && npm run lint || echo 'Frontend lint not configured'

author: FinAutoJobs Team
